run_merge_stats: run the merge_stats CLI to combine per-task statistics from a folder into a single merged JSON file
run_merge_stats_with_output: run merge_stats with a custom output path to save merged statistics to a specified JSON file
run_merge_stats_default_path: run merge_stats using the current directory as the default stats folder to aggregate all stats files
use_pipeline_stats_sum: use PipelineStats to sum multiple per-task statistics objects into a single merged statistics object
use_pipeline_stats_from_json: use PipelineStats.from_json to deserialize a JSON statistics file into a PipelineStats object
